rulings.decision: The reach is ruled here, once, for S6-01 and S6-02. GATE-E5 condition 3's clause 'no new 7-gram shared across rows from FIXUP-4 text' reaches gate 10 only. It is the delta form of GATE-E4's 'with 0 offending rows' and it asks for what the pinned gate-10 run returns. It does not reach a 7-gram shared by fewer than ten rows. This is the narrower of the two readings, and it is stated as that. It is a construction of E5's words, not an amendment of them. The HARD ngram7 member stays as it was, at gate 10; this book never had a gate below 10. Condition 3 is met. W3-005 device_notes keeps the bytes R5-S5-11 ordered, and no bytes change. S6's measurement stands, and S6 was right to report the question and not choose: what falls is the status not_met and the severity, not the count.
rulings.reason: The reach is INFERRED from four grounds in the bytes, because E5 records no intent. (1) Slot: GATE-E4 reads 'ngram7 GREEN at gate 10 with 0 offending rows.' E5 keeps the same sentence and fills the same slot for a delta check, so the clause does the work 'with 0 offending rows' did. (2) Frame: condition 3 opens 'run_validator_suite.py on the FIXUP-4 applied rows:' and lists what that one run returns. The suite calls ngram7 with no argument, so at GATE 10, and TOOLKIT line 173 states the class as 'shared by 10 or more rows'. E5 names no device below 10. (3) Coherence: E5 ordered these bytes, tested 'the full FIXUP-4 set' and named only gate 10 in what it tested, and condition 1 requires them byte for byte. On the reading below gate 10, no faithful apply could meet conditions 1 and 3 together. A reading under which obeying the order fails the gate set by the same ruling is worse than one that leaves a clause idle. (4) Usage: E4 used the same words for authors, 'no sentence is shared across rows (ngram7)', and decided them at gate 10, while the W6-007 and W6-009 pair shared a sentence frame in FIXUP-3. In FIXUP-4 no author chose a word. Against this ruling: the clause carries no row count, and on this reading it adds nothing to GREEN. That cost is accepted and said plainly: E5 wrote a clause with no work of its own. Substance does not press the other way. The six 7-grams each sit in exactly two rows and are one-token variants of frames the same pairs already shared. Shared 7-grams fell from 269 to 255 and worst reuse stays at 8 rows. S6's candidate passes every run, and it is not ordered because the bytes hold no defect for it to cure; on W3-005 it returns the row to a frame it left, taking two 7-grams from 6 rows to 7.
